# Social Elite Marketing Group

> San Antonio-based performance marketing agency running data-driven paid media, lead generation, website builds, and white-label fulfillment for brands that measure every dollar.

Social Elite Marketing Group (SEMG) operates disciplined acquisition systems across 50+ industries — home services, med spas, SaaS, legal, real estate, and funding. Services include media buying (Meta, Google, TikTok), full-service digital marketing, website development, lead generation, strategy, white-label media buying for agencies, and business funding partnerships. Founded by Jeremy Garcia with 6+ years of performance marketing experience.
